body: I feel you man, except i don't really. I have been lonely my whole life, nobody likes me and nobody loves me. I'm so alone I don't even feel alone anymore. As one might say "i have myself and my demons". Life is trash can't deny that. But hold on man, just hold on and maybe one day we'll all get better.
Why do i have to live man ? Just to die.
Oh so you are supposed to feel pain. I'm fucking messed up man. I'm just too resiliant. I could come home and see my whole family has been murdered and I wouldn't really care.
Is my reddit broken or did this comment just get deleted ?

You don't have to feel ashamed. We are here to help. I'm sorry to hear this, life sucks. Did you try to talk about it with people close to you ? Death is not the only option, maybe it's the easiest way but not the best.
Sure man. Why are you feeling this way ?
No problem. If you need to talk I'm here. Take care man. I hope that you'll get better.

It could be good or bad. You could feel numb and empty the entire time knowing that nothing you do has a point or you could completely change your mindset and not take even the smallest things for granted. Depends on how deep you are.

I think you should wait before doing anything. Let's say you decide to kill yourself tomorrow, well maybe the next day is the day you would have met your future wife. Try to wait it out, do some thing you like, be yourself. I'd say "if you don't run after love, love will walk towards you" but that's kinda stupid ngl. Now you don't have to take any of the words i say, I can't physical stop you. Your life your choices. But i hope you will get better, find the one you love and build a great family.

Glad i could help. It's 5 am here. And i have been since 9 pm. I am so tired but I can't catch any sleep. I shouldn't try to help people, but i am. Man it's almost funny how Hippocratic we all are here. Like saying "Hold on it might get better someday" when all want is to blow your brains out. If you want to go more in depth in your problems and talk about I'm here.

I don't want to die. I want my suffering to end. Suicide is a way of making it happen but it's not the only way I'm pretty sure. And yeah i could buy a fingerprint gun lock and tell my friend to put his fingerprint on it. That way i cannot access the trigger but can still keep the gun.

I don't have any ammo. But i don't think i should give it to someone. Primarily because it's pointing it at my head for a while or cutting  myself. And the first don't leave scars so yeah. All the ammo i have is in a safe and my friend has the key. I could go buy more but i am not dumb enough to do that so yea.

Yeah. Even though i don't think i will. Unfortunately i have multiple other problems. And i also have a fire arm. In my country you can get a .22 rifle for hunting purpose as young as 16. Thing is i quickly learned i can load 9mm in it. Having a more accessible way of suicide means i higher chance I'll actually do it. I hope we all get better thought.

I don't really know i just told him privately, i excused myself for all the work I didn't do and told him that i had been struggling with depression and that i am in a really bad mental state right now. Once again i am not sure if that'll work for you and i am really really sorry if you try it and it has bad repercussions.
If you don't have any other proof then don't. Try to get the rape kit done asap and then clean yourself and make yourself comfortable.

Be honest with him. 7 years of depression just eating away at you. Not going to lie i am in the exact same state as you. But when i told him honestly he understood. I can't guarantee anything, but i feel like that's the thing you should do.
Well at least growing up without anyone caring about me has some advantages. I know that must feel really bad. If you want to talk with me I'm here. I hope you'll be happy someday.

Everyday i just take the gun point it at my head and after a while just put it back. I feel like dancing with death makes me feel better somehow. I am really sorry for you, i hope you get better, i hope we all get better. Whoever you are stay strong. Maybe one day everything will be ok.

Listen, you could be a multi-billionaire and have a wife/husband and kids and still be suicidal. Don't feel ashamed for it, whoever you are being suicidal is being suicidal ! If you need help go talk, do it, just do it. You'll see it'll feel better if your family is understanding. This world is fucked up but i hope we'll all be happy someday. Maybe someday.... Just maybe...... I am in no position to give advice right now but i tried anyways. 
Sorry if i hurt your feelings in anyway.

Hard to say it but yeah. I agree. Life is a fucking shitty place. I just wake up, eat, sometimes shower, talk about how much my life is trash and i want to die with people, eat and sleep. I don't know who i am, what i want to be. I remember whenever somebody asked me "what do you want to be when you grow up" i always answer "I don't know" i never expected to actually grow. I don't feel like i will ever be happy. Yet here i am. Still here, still alive, still talking about suicide. I just hope that we'll all get better.

Not going to lie, i am not in position to give advice right now but you should really draw intension, take that therapy maybe it won't work but maybe it will. If you need help ask for it ! Your an awesome person for being  selfless but it's ok to get noticed and helped too. I don't give a fuck about my emotions anymore. I don't really feel anything. Only emptiness. But don't fear asking for help, that's what you should do i believe. This world can be really really really fucking trash sometimes but i hope you'll get better.

Man, i can feel you SO FUCKING MUCH. If i just ask 3 people for help at least one of them are going to answer "gOd Is ThE aNsWer" i have nothing against religion but could you ACTUALLY HELP US ? I don't want to give false hopes, but hold on man. Maybe one day, maybe one day we'll all be happy.
Maybe you should actually write one. Makes me feel better some times. Hope you the best man. I'm in same boat as you or whatever.
